intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in North East for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from December 3 (Elf on a Shelf StoryTime) through December 16 (Gingerbread Houses), with the Christmas Tree Lighting in Downtown Elkton (December 4), All Aboard the Polar Express (December 9) and Preschool Art: Reindeer Fun (December 15) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in North East

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in North East
  • 4 free events, all at the North East Branch Library: Elf on a Shelf StoryTime, All Aboard the Polar Express, Preschool Art: Reindeer Fun and Gingerbread Houses
  • Meet Santa: Christmas Tree Lighting in Downtown Elkton
  • Trains: All Aboard the Polar Express pajama storytime (December 9)
  • Season: December 3, 2026 to December 16, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? North East families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Baltimore, which covers The Polar Express Train Ride at the B&O Railroad Museum, the Mayor's Christmas Parade, Merriweather Symphony of Lights and Christmas Village at the Inner Harbor.
